course.title: Internet Programming
course.overview: Comprehensive 3rd-Year University course covering Internet & Web Architectures, TCP/IP & Application Protocols, HTTP/1.1 to HTTP/3 Message Lifecycles, Semantic HTML5 Engineering, Advanced CSS3 Layout Engines (Flexbox, CSS Grid), Client-Side JavaScript Runtime Internals (Execution Contexts, Closures, Event Loop, DOM Tree Manipulation), and Secure Full-Stack Web Development.
